Purpose
-------
Create a safe workflow to push `.github` changes from a non-template repo back into the canonical template and then roll the merged template changes out to dependent repositories via PRs.

Prerequisites
-------------
- `git` and `gh` (GitHub CLI) installed and authenticated. `gh` must have repo and workflow scopes for the org.
- Local clone of the repository where `.github` changes were made.
- The user must have push/PR permissions on the template and target repositories.

Overview (high level)
---------------------
1. Compute the list of changed files under `.github` in the current repo.
2. Create a new branch in the template repository, copy those `.github` files into it, commit and open a PR against the template.
3. Wait for the template PR to be merged (poll `gh`), then fetch the merged files from the template and create per-repo PRs applying the same changes to dependent repos.

Dry-run (preview)
-----------------
```powershell
# Show changed files under .github between HEAD and origin/main (or specified base)
$base = $env:SYNC_BASE -or 'origin/main'
$changed = git diff --name-only $base -- .github | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }
if (-not $changed) { Write-Host "No .github changes detected between HEAD and $base"; exit }
Write-Host "Changed .github files:`n"; $changed

# Proposed template PR branch name
$repo = (git remote get-url origin) -replace '.*[:/](.+?)/(.+?)(\.git)?$','$2'
$templateBranch = "chore/sync-github-from-$repo"
Write-Host "Template PR branch: $templateBranch"

# Proposed dependent repos (preview .github/repos.txt or query gh)
$reposFile = '.github/repos.txt'
if (Test-Path $reposFile) { Get-Content $reposFile } else { Write-Host "No repos.txt found; will query org on apply." }
```

Apply (safe, step-by-step)
--------------------------
Use the following snippet to perform an end-to-end sync. It supports `-DryRun` to preview actions without pushing.

```powershell
param(
  [switch]$DryRun,
  [string]$TemplateRepo = 'winccoa-tools-pack/template-npm-shared-library',
  [string]$ReposList = '.github/repos.txt',
  [string]$BranchPrefix = 'chore/sync-github-from',
  [string]$Base = 'origin/main'
)

function Exec([string]$cmd) { Write-Host "> $cmd"; if (-not $DryRun) { iex $cmd } }

# 1. Compute changed files under .github
$changed = git diff --name-only $Base -- .github | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }
if (-not $changed) { Write-Host "No .github changes found; aborting."; exit }

# 2. Create branch in template and copy files
$originUrl = git remote get-url origin
$repoName = $originUrl -replace '.*[:/](.+?)/(.+?)(\.git)?$','$2'
$branch = "$BranchPrefix-$repoName"
Write-Host "Preparing template branch $branch for $TemplateRepo"

# Clone template (shallow) into a temp dir
$tmp = New-TemporaryFile; Remove-Item $tmp; $tmpDir = Join-Path $env:TEMP ([System.Guid]::NewGuid().ToString()); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $tmpDir | Out-Null
Exec("git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/$TemplateRepo.git `"$tmpDir`"")
Push-Location $tmpDir
Exec("git checkout -b $branch")

# Copy changed files into template clone
foreach ($f in $changed) {
  $src = Join-Path (Get-Location -Path ..) $f
  $dst = Join-Path $tmpDir $f
  $dir = Split-Path $dst
  if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
  Write-Host "Copying $src -> $dst"
  if (-not $DryRun) { Copy-Item $src -Destination $dst -Force }
}

# Commit & push template branch
Exec("git add .github && git commit -m 'chore: sync .github changes from $repoName' -q || echo 'No changes to commit'")
Exec("git push --set-upstream origin $branch")

# Open PR against template
if (Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
  $prUrl = if ($DryRun) { "DRYRUN-pr://$TemplateRepo/$branch" } else { gh pr create --repo $TemplateRepo --title "chore: sync .github from $repoName" --body "Sync .github changes from $repoName" --head $branch --base main --label chore --json url -q | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty url }
  Write-Host "Template PR: $prUrl"
} else { Write-Host "gh not installed; created branch $branch in $TemplateRepo. Create PR manually." }

Pop-Location

# 3. Wait for template PR to be merged
if (-not $DryRun) {
  if (-not (Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Host "gh required to poll PR status; exiting."; exit }
  Write-Host "Waiting for template PR to be merged..."
  $merged = $false
  while (-not $merged) {
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 10
    $prs = gh pr list --repo $TemplateRepo --head $branch --state all --json number,state,url -q
    if (-not $prs) { Write-Host "PR not found yet; sleeping..."; continue }
    $pr = $prs | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($pr.state -eq 'MERGED') { $merged = $true; Write-Host "Template PR merged."; break }
    if ($pr.state -eq 'CLOSED') { Write-Host "Template PR closed without merge; aborting rollout."; exit }
    Write-Host "PR state: $($pr.state); sleeping..."
  }
}

# 4. Rollout to dependent repositories
Write-Host "Collecting dependent repositories..."
$targets = @()
if (Test-Path $ReposList) { $targets = Get-Content $ReposList | Where-Object { $_ -match '.+/.+' } } else {
  # Query org repos (requires gh)
  if (Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    $org = ($TemplateRepo -split '/')[0]
    Write-Host "Querying repos in org $org"
    $targets = gh repo list $org --limit 1000 --json nameWithOwner -q | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { $_.nameWithOwner }
  } else { Write-Host "No ReposList and gh missing; cannot determine targets; aborting."; exit }
}

foreach ($t in $targets) {
  Write-Host "Preparing PR for $t"
  $tRepo = $t
  $tmp2 = Join-Path $env:TEMP ([System.Guid]::NewGuid().ToString())
  Exec("git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/$tRepo.git `"$tmp2`"")
  Push-Location $tmp2
  $tbranch = "$BranchPrefix-$repoName"
  Exec("git checkout -b $tbranch")
  foreach ($f in $changed) {
    $src = Join-Path (Join-Path $tmpDir $f) -Resolve
    $dst = Join-Path $tmp2 $f
    $d = Split-Path $dst
    if (-not (Test-Path $d)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d -Force | Out-Null }
    Write-Host "Applying $f to $tRepo"
    if (-not $DryRun) { Copy-Item $src -Destination $dst -Force }
  }
  Exec("git add .github && git commit -m 'chore: apply .github sync from template' -q || echo 'No changes to commit'")
  Exec("git push --set-upstream origin $tbranch")
  if (Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    if (-not $DryRun) {
      gh pr create --repo $tRepo --title "chore: apply .github sync from template" --body "This PR applies .github updates that were merged into $TemplateRepo" --head $tbranch --base main
    } else { Write-Host "DRYRUN: would create PR for $tRepo from $tbranch" }
  } else { Write-Host "gh missing; pushed branch $tbranch for $tRepo. Create PR manually." }
  Pop-Location
}

Write-Host "Done. Review opened PRs and merge when ready."
```

Notes & Tips
-------------
- Use `-DryRun` first to preview repository targets and branch names without modifying remote repositories.
- If your target repos use `main` or another default branch name, change the `--base` or branch naming accordingly.
- If dependent repos are many, consider batching rollout to reduce API and CI load.
- Consider adding a `repos.txt` in the org `.github` to declare which repos should receive template updates; the script will prefer that file when present.
